description: Source code for a Kubernetes admission plugin named 'ImagePolicyWebhook' that implements an admission controller for image policy enforcement via webhooks.

classes.name: Plugin
classes.description: Implements the admission.ValidationInterface for image policy webhook validation, manages webhook communication, caching, and validation logic.

methods.name: statusTTL
methods.description: Determines cache TTL based on review status allowance.

methods.name: filterAnnotations
methods.description: Filters annotations to include only those matching *.image-policy.k8s.io/*.

methods.name: webhookError
methods.description: Handles errors contacting the webhook backend, optionally allowing resources if defaultAllow is true.

methods.name: Validate
methods.description: Performs admission validation for pods and ephemeral containers, invoking the webhook and applying policies.

methods.name: admitPod
methods.description: Sends image review requests to the webhook, caches responses, and applies admission decisions.

methods.name: NewImagePolicyWebhook
methods.description: Creates a new instance of the image policy webhook plugin from a configuration file.
